what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan still regenerates tally-plan-review.sh although tally_plan_review() is in-process only and never runs the embedded bash
scenario_or_breakage: tally_plan_review() returns plan_review_tally.main(list(argv)) and the comment states the gzip blob is retained but not executed. suggested_fix: Drop skills/design/scripts/tally-plan-review.sh from the nine-script regen list.
